data.one_liner: Provide User-Agent Client Hints to Flutter for Android, iOS, macOS, and Web.
data.what_it_does: It provides APIs to retrieve User-Agent strings, UserAgentData, and HTTP headers containing User-Agent Client Hints. It supports Android, iOS, macOS, and Web platforms.
use_when: You need to send User-Agent Client Hints in your HTTP request headers.
You want to read detailed device and platform information like architecture, model, and platform version.
avoid_when: You do not need HTTP User-Agent headers or device metadata.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, macOS, and Web.
Provides convenient helper functions for popular networking libraries like Dio.
weaknesses: On Web, some high-entropy hints may be empty depending on browser support.
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec.yaml via 'flutter pub add ua_client_hints'.
data.minimal_example:
final String ua = await userAgent();
print('User-Agent: $ua');
